subject: general
question: Ajay drives 10 km from Point A towards the east. He then takes a right turn, drives 5 km, turns left and drives 10 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given:

Ajay starts from Point A (0, 0)

10 km East

Right turn → 5 km South

Left turn → 10 km East

Left turn → 5 km North

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b3e6db4c67f6e7a4b2cab649d4b79b57182cbab5e4acc357df61fbde069fac3.png] 

So, To return to Point A, Ajay must move 20 km West.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
